steps.name: Missing entity
steps.do: Open **Set restaurant as closed**. Leave the restaurant blank, fill the other required fields, and submit.

steps.name: Daily viewing times
steps.do: Open **Set animal visibility schedule**. Choose an exhibit and species, leave the daily viewing start and end times blank, and submit.
steps.expect: **Daily viewing start and end times are required.**

steps.name: Weekly preset locks
steps.do: Open a restaurant or gift shop opening-schedule form. Choose **Weekends only**, then try the **Holidays** checkbox.
steps.expect: The **Holidays** checkbox locks or otherwise follows the preset rules for **Weekends only**.

steps.name: Attraction hours inverted
steps.do: Open **Set attraction hours**. Set the weekday start time after the weekday end time, then submit.
steps.expect: **Weekday start time must be before weekday end time.**

steps.name: Hours outside zoo hours
steps.do: Open **Set attraction hours**. Enter weekday or weekend hours outside regular zoo hours for the selected date range, then submit.
steps.expect: **Attraction hours must fall within regular zoo hours for the selected date range.** or **Weekday hours must fall within regular zoo hours.**

steps.name: Duplicate encounter time
steps.do: Open **Set Wild Encounter schedule**. Add the same encounter time twice, then submit.
steps.expect: **Each encounter time can only be added once.**

steps.name: Empty required message
steps.do: Open **Set restroom alert**. Choose a restroom, leave **Alert message** blank, and submit.

steps.name: Overlap Cancel
steps.do: Open an opening-schedule or hours form that overlaps an existing schedule so **Schedule conflict** appears, then click **Cancel**.
